steps.title: savanna: plantgen package route against library route
steps.intro: A new 200 ft savanna map (seed 1234), built once in authoring and never saved. a_* lays plantgen's lib_slice_pkg over the installed palette (PaletteLibrary.overlay_package); b_* serves the treecube palette with the content library D:/dev/plantgen/out/lib_slice compiled over it by LibraryRegistry (the same savanna_summer_s1 biome, rules and assets compiled from the library files), with the same cameras; c_* has the override cleared again. The two routes should look the same: the plants differ only where the mesh compression of a runtime parse differs. Fades off, wind frozen.
